criteria_results.text: POST /agent-sessions with agentId='secretary' resolves the real Secretary profile's allowed_mcps_json before creating the opencode session, passes the resulting mcpRoleConfig to the initial opencodeClient.createSession call, excludes servers not allowed by that profile, and persists the effective mcp_role and mcp_allowed_tools_json on the Rhythm session.
criteria_results.notes: Manual smoke: a brand-new Secretary session showed ALL MCP servers present — profile scope had zero effect at runtime, despite the scope commit (a30510f44) being live in the running fork (engine 0.0.0-fix/issue-761-agents-ui-render-202606272206, capability=true). The c1 integration test (issue_secretary_profile_scope.test.ts, 137 lines) asserts the controller resolves the profile, persists mcp_role/mcp_allowed_tools_json, and passes mcpRoleConfig to a MOCKED opencodeClient.createSession. It never asserts that the resulting fork session actually excludes the disallowed servers. The criterion's 'excludes servers not allowed by that profile' clause was therefore verified at the api_server boundary only — a false negative across the api_server->fork seam. The scope commit touched only agent_sessions_controller.ts (+11 lines): it sends the config but the initial fork session does not enforce it.

criteria_results.text: POST /agent-sessions for a profile with no allowed_mcps_json remains unrestricted and does not invent an MCP role or allowlist.
criteria_results.notes: Marked not_tested in the contract (manual follow-up). Not exercised in this smoke.

process_issues.description: During the first full API suite run, one tasks_controller test returned HTML instead of JSON; the same file passed 26/26 in isolation and the full PR suite passed on rerun without code changes. Symptom (HTML body in a controller test) suggests a request reached a live/dev HTML-serving endpoint rather than the test fixture during the full-suite run — a test-isolation/server-bleed flake, not a glob overlap, so it is not force-fit to P2.
process_issues.detected_by: Full API suite run output noted in the handoff; isolation rerun + full PR rerun both green.

issues.description: verification-gate reported PASS (73 targeted + TypeScript) for a criterion whose text demands runtime exclusion of disallowed MCP servers, but the only test backing it mocked opencodeClient.createSession and asserted the argument — no captured evidence that the real fork session excludes servers. The PASS claim rested on a boundary-only false green. This is the C2 root cause surfacing as a premature/insufficiently-evidenced completion claim.
issues.detected_by: git show a30510f44 (test mocks createSession); contract c1 text vs test assertions; manual smoke contradicted the PASS.

failure_output: Manual smoke (user-observed): brand-new Secretary session showed ALL MCP servers present. Profile-derived MCP scope had no effect at runtime. No exception thrown — silent non-enforcement at the api_server->fork session-creation seam.
suggested_follow_up: acceptance-contract must require an end-to-end assertion that the created opencode session's resolved MCP tool set actually excludes disallowed servers (assert against a real/fake fork session's resolved tools), not merely that mcpRoleConfig was passed to a mocked createSession.
